annotations.title: Get current US CD rates by term

description: Current US CD APYs: FDIC national averages by term plus RateZip-observed institution CD rates with terms, minimums/conditions, observation timestamps, source URLs, and staleness status. Pass term_months (e.g. 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 60) to filter to one term or omit for all terms grouped by term; if no institution publishes the requested term, available terms are listed. Optional balance resolves applicable balance-tier APYs and re-ranks by earnings; state adds an availability/eligibility note; credit_score returns a clarifying note only (CD APYs do not vary by credit). Use for current CD rate listings by term; use compare_deposit_options for multi-constraint fee/direct-deposit/state matching, or get_rate_watch_report for historical rate-change alerts and brokered CDs. Factual rate data only; does not endorse providers, offer financial advice, open accounts, or submit applications. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

balance.description: Deposit balance in USD — resolves the applicable tier APY and ranks by what you'd earn

credit_score.description: FICO — deposit APYs generally don't vary by credit; returns a clarifying note only

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/eligibility note

term_months.description: CD term in months to filter to (e.g. 6, 12, 24, 60). Omit for all terms grouped by term.

name: get_cd_rates

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the normalized rate cache.

observed.description: RateZip-observed institution rate rows with APY, applicable_apy, conditions, observed_at, source_url, and staleness.

reference.description: FDIC national average reference rate(s) via FRED.
